name: 岩石（力学/物理/水理）测试

map.计算岩石单轴抗压强度（力学）、干密度（物理）、吸水率与软化系数（水理）等参数，输: Compute rock parameters such as uniaxial compressive strength (mechanical), dry density (physical), water absorption and softening coefficient (hydraulic): enter the test data and the tool calculates automatically and gives a rock quality assessment.
map.📖 查看「岩石力学三参数（抗压/密度/软化）计算使用指南」: 📖 View the "Rock Mechanics Three Parameters (Compressive/Density/Softening) Calculation Guide"
map.浮力质量 m₃（g，水中称量）: Buoyant mass m₃ (g, weighed in water)
map.干密度 ρd = m₁/(m₂-m₃)×ρw；吸水率 Wa = (m₂-m₁)/: Dry density ρd = m₁/(m₂-m₃)×ρw; water absorption Wa = (m₂-m₁)/m₁×100%
map.软化系数 K = σcw / σcd，K<0.75 为软化岩石: Softening coefficient K = σcw / σcd; K<0.75 indicates a softening rock
map.单轴抗压强度：σc = P/A，A 为受压面积，试样高径比建议 2:1: Uniaxial compressive strength: σc = P/A, where A is the loaded area; a height-to-diameter ratio of 2:1 is recommended
map.干密度采用水中称量法：ρd = m₁/(m₂-m₃)×ρw（ρw=1.0 g/c: Dry density by the water-weighing method: ρd = m₁/(m₂-m₃)×ρw (ρw=1.0 g/cm³)
map.吸水率反映岩石孔隙率，一般 Wa<1% 为致密岩石: Water absorption reflects rock porosity; Wa<1% generally indicates a dense rock
map.软化系数 K<0.75 为软化岩石（遇水强度显著降低），工程中需特别注意: K<0.75 indicates a softening rock (strength drops markedly on wetting) and needs particular attention in engineering
map.📚 深度解析：岩石力学三参数（抗压/密度/软化）计算: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Rock Mechanics Three Parameters (Compressive/Density/Softening) Calculation
map.抗压强度：由破坏荷载与试件直径算单轴抗压强度 σc 并判坚硬程度: Compressive strength: compute the uniaxial compressive strength σc from the failure load and specimen diameter and classify the hardness
map.物理参数：由干/饱和/湿质量算干密度、饱和密度与吸水率，评孔隙特征: Physical parameters: compute dry density, saturated density and water absorption from the dry/saturated/wet masses to assess the pore characteristics
map.水理参数：由干/饱和抗压强度算软化系数，判遇水强度折减: Hydraulic parameters: compute the softening coefficient from the dry/saturated compressive strengths to judge the strength reduction on wetting
map.公式：①单轴抗压 σc=P×1000/A，A=πd²/4（P 破坏荷载 N、d: Formula: ① uniaxial compressive σc=P×1000/A, A=πd²/4 (P the failure load in N, d the diameter in mm, σc in MPa); hardness grading σc≥120 hard, 60-120 fairly hard, 30-60 fairly soft, 5-30 soft, <5 very soft. ② dry density ρd=md/(ms−mw), water absorption Wa=(ms−md)/md×100% (md dry mass, ms saturated mass, mw wet mass, in g). ③ softening coefficient K=σcw/σcd (computed locally, units unified to g and mm).
map.例：P=120kN、d=50mm → A=1963.5 mm²、σc=12000: Example: P=120 kN, d=50 mm → A=1963.5 mm², σc=120000/1963.5=61.11 MPa (fairly hard rock); md=250, ms=255, mw=158 → ρd=2.577 g/cm³, ρs=2.629 g/cm³, Wa=2.00% (medium porosity); dry/saturated compressive cd=85, cw=55 → K=0.647 (weak softening, strength reduced by about 35.3% on wetting).
map.软化系数低于多少不能用？: Below what softening coefficient is a rock unusable?
map.一般 K<0.75 视为软化岩石，水利工程等饱水环境须按饱和强度设计；K≥0.7: Generally K<0.75 is treated as a softening rock; in water-saturated environments such as hydraulic engineering the design must use the saturated strength. K≥0.75 indicates good water resistance. The exact threshold depends on the project type and code (such as dam foundations and slopes); results are for reference.
map.试件直径影响 σc 吗？: Does the specimen diameter affect σc?
map.σc 已用 A=πd²/4 归一化，理论上与直径无关；但高径比须满足规范（通常≥: σc is normalised by A=πd²/4, so in theory it is independent of diameter; however the height-to-diameter ratio must meet the code (usually ≥2), otherwise end effects make it low. This tool only computes the strength; shape correction must follow the test code.
map.岩石力学参数计算工具，支持单轴抗压强度（力学）、干密度与吸水率（物理）、软化系数: A rock mechanics parameter calculator supporting the computation and assessment of three common rock test parameters: uniaxial compressive strength (mechanical), dry density and water absorption (physical), and softening coefficient (hydraulic).

map.软化系数计算与耐水性评价: Softening coefficient calculation and water-resistance assessment
map.工程地质勘察岩石参数计算: Rock parameter calculation for engineering geological surveys
